BiblicalUsage: Yithrah is abundance, the wealth a person has gathered and laid up. In Isaiah 15:7 "the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows," and in Jeremiah 48:36 "the riches that he hath gotten are perished." In both verses the gathered wealth does not last: it is carried off, or it perishes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word warns me about what I lay up, because the abundance of Moab in Isaiah 15:7 and Jeremiah 48:36 was carried away and perished, and the only wealth that stays is the one laid up where no enemy carries it off.
